overview: Katta Castellum is the Loyalist city-state on Luclin, founded after the schism with Sanctus Seru.
history: Constructed as a fortified civic republic after the Loyalists split from Seru.
Designed with Roman-inspired ward architecture: civic, arcane, military, and political districts.
The Senate governs through debate, decree, and arcane oversight.
The Arcane Quarter maintains magical stability across Luclin’s surface.
hooks: A Senate decree shifts political tensions with Sanctus Seru.
Arcane stabilizers in the Resonance Labs fluctuate unexpectedly.
A diplomatic envoy arrives from Shadow Haven.
A census audit reveals anomalies in the Residential Quarter.
